about: Modwerk's Model:Cycles OS 1.13 base, built by npm run machine:base -- model-cycles: core-mc 0.3's source from Elekloader v0.11.0, unchanged (sdk/imports/core-mc-source-f20ffda.json). Its copy of core-mc's mod.json (copies) differs in the collections alone: every hook holds 8 subscribers, not 4, as sdk/machines/model-cycles/events.json records. The reference keeps everything of the core-mc 0.3 release but its collections, whose room this base raises; built with the reviewed toolchain, the package differs from the release in the collections alone.
